mapper.update: UPDATE board SET views = views + 1 WHERE board_id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT b.board_id AS boardId, b.campaign_id AS campaignId, b.author_id AS authorId, b.title, b.content, b.category, b.views, b.likes, b.is_pinned AS isPinned, b.created_at AS createdAt, m.name AS authorName FROM BOARD b JOIN MEMBER m ON b.author_id = m.member_id WHERE b.board_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD (campaign_id, author_id, title, content, category, is_pinned) VALUES ( #{campaignId}, #{authorId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{category}, #{isPinned} )
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, category = #{category}, campaign_id = #{campaignId} WHERE board_id = #{boardId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM BOARD_LIKE WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS BOARD_LIKE ( like_id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, board_id BIGINT NOT NULL, member_id BIGINT NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (like_id), UNIQUE KEY uq_board_member_like (board_id, member_id), CONSTRAINT fk_like_board FOREIGN KEY (board_id) REFERENCES BOARD (board_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_like_member FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES MEMBER (member_id) ON DELETE CASCADE )
